hero.title: Integrated solutions for inclusive and resilient territories
hero.statement: Restore land. Assess impacts. Act for sustainable development.
hero.lead: SEI supports institutions and development actors in designing and implementing solutions with strong environmental and social impact across Africa.

quote: « African ecosystems and the populations who depend on them are today facing growing vulnerability. Climate change, land degradation, biodiversity loss and human pressure on natural resources are weakening livelihoods, deepening inequalities and can fuel tensions within territories.

Faced with these challenges, I am convinced that responses must combine scientific expertise, knowledge of local realities, community participation and institutional commitment. With SEI, our ambition is to bridge international commitments, public policy and action on the ground, in order to protect ecosystems, strengthen community resilience and contribute to sustainable, inclusive development adapted to African realities. »

identity.title: A committed firm serving sustainable development
identity.ambition: Turn environmental, social and climate challenges into levers for action, peace and resilience for African communities and territories.
paragraphs: Social & Eco Impact (SEI) is a consulting, research and strategy firm working on sustainable land management, environmental and social impact assessment, and responses to peace, mobility and climate change challenges.

SEI supports public institutions, local authorities, international organisations, and technical and financial partners in designing, implementing, monitoring and evaluating high-impact policies, strategies, projects and programmes across Africa.

history.title: Our history
paragraphs: Founded in 2024 and operational since 2026, Social & Eco Impact (SEI) is a consulting firm based in Tunis, working with States, institutions, development partners, businesses and communities across Africa.

SEI was born from its founder's experience implementing the three Rio Conventions on biodiversity, climate change and desertification. His international career, notably within the Sahara and Sahel Observatory (OSS), was built through coordinating and implementing projects and programmes carried out in partnership with the Global Mechanism of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). It was further enriched by experience with the main international environmental and climate finance mechanisms, including the Adaptation Fund, the Green Climate Fund and the Global Environment Facility.

Having coordinated major environmental and climate projects and led numerous field missions and institutional support assignments with ministries in Benin, Burkina Faso, Niger, the Central African Republic, the Republic of Guinea, Seychelles and Tunisia, its founder gained a concrete understanding of the realities facing African territories.

His career has also been marked by an active contribution to implementing the Great Green Wall Initiative, notably through leading stakeholder consultation and coordination mechanisms, as well as designing and developing regional projects dedicated to land restoration, climate change adaptation and strengthening community resilience.

This experience gave rise to a strong conviction: international commitments and public policies only deliver lasting results when translated into concrete solutions, adapted to local realities and designed as close as possible to their beneficiaries.

SEI was created to bring technical expertise, international standards and financing mechanisms closer to the real needs of territories. The firm supports its partners in the sustainable management of land and natural resources, the assessment and management of environmental and social risks, climate change adaptation, biodiversity conservation, and the design of transformative, inclusive and resilient projects.

values.title: Our values
values.text: At SEI, we place integrity, accountability and fairness at the heart of our commitment. We favour listening and dialogue, combining institutional expertise with the knowledge and realities of communities. Our interventions are built on rigour, transparency and the pursuit of concrete, inclusive and sustainable solutions, generating tangible, measurable results for the benefit of communities and ecosystems.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: Contributing to more resilient African territories, where the sustainable management of natural resources protects ecosystems, secures community livelihoods and prevents tensions exacerbated by climate change.

expertiseIntro.title: Linking international commitments to territorial realities.
expertiseIntro.text: SEI supports the integrated implementation of, and synergies between, the Rio Conventions on biodiversity, climate and desertification. Our expertise helps restore land and ecosystems, manage environmental and social risks, and strengthen the resilience of communities and territories.
expertiseIntro.sectionTitle: Natural capital and territorial resilience at the heart of our work

expertises.title: Sustainable land management and LDN
expertises.summary: SEI supports public actors and their partners in the sustainable management of land and in achieving Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN). Our expertise covers preventing and reducing degradation, restoring land and ecosystems, and planning and monitoring national commitments.

interventions.title: Ecological rehabilitation and sustainable repurposing of degraded mining sites
interventions.text: Conducting diagnostics, developing restoration plans, supporting soil rehabilitation, revegetation and defining sustainable uses — including agricultural uses where soil quality allows.

interventions.title: Data production, mapping and monitoring of land degradation
interventions.text: Assessing degradation trends, identifying priority areas, defining Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) targets and measuring the effectiveness of interventions using GIS, remote sensing and monitoring indicators.

interventions.title: Mainstreaming LDN into policy and territorial planning
interventions.text: Supporting institutions in integrating LDN objectives into national and territorial policies, strategies, investment plans and development programmes.

interventions.title: Institutional and technical capacity building
interventions.text: Designing training, guides, operational manuals and decision-support tools, complemented by hands-on support for institutions, local authorities and field actors.

interventions.title: Project design and financing mobilisation
interventions.text: Preparing concept notes, feasibility studies and funding proposals dedicated to sustainable land management, ecosystem restoration and achieving LDN.

expertises.impact: Restore the ecological and productive functions of degraded land, support sustainable food production and guide public action through reliable data, in order to accelerate progress toward Land Degradation Neutrality.

expertises.title: Environmental and social assessment
expertises.summary: SEI supports project developers in identifying, assessing and managing environmental and social risks throughout their intervention cycle. Our approach aims to preserve ecosystems, protect communities and promote responsible projects that comply with national regulations and international standards.

interventions.title: Conducting environmental and social assessments
interventions.text: Carrying out impact studies (ESIA), impact notices and strategic environmental assessments, including risk analysis, effects on ecosystems and communities, and defining appropriate mitigation measures.

interventions.title: Developing and operationalising environmental and social management instruments
interventions.text: Designing environmental and social management plans (ESMP), procedures, budgets and monitoring indicators, together with support for implementation and corrective measures.

interventions.title: Stakeholder consultation and mobilisation
interventions.text: Mapping stakeholders, conducting inclusive consultations, developing engagement plans and setting up accessible grievance-handling mechanisms.

interventions.title: Gender mainstreaming and inclusion of vulnerable groups
interventions.text: Conducting social and gender analyses, defining inclusion measures and integrating specific indicators to prevent disproportionate impacts and promote equitable participation.

interventions.title: Environmental and social audit, monitoring and reporting
interventions.text: Conducting compliance audits and field monitoring missions, setting up dashboards and preparing reports that meet regulatory requirements and financial partners' standards.

expertises.impact: Anticipate and manage environmental and social risks, reduce impacts on ecosystems and communities, and strengthen the acceptability, compliance and long-term performance of projects.

expertises.title: Peace, mobility and climate change
expertises.summary: SEI supports institutions, territories and communities in anticipating the effects of climate change on natural resources, livelihoods and human mobility. Our approach aims to strengthen community resilience, prevent tensions linked to resource access, and promote inclusive responses adapted to local realities.

interventions.title: Participatory planning and prevention of natural resource conflicts
interventions.text: Conducting participatory diagnostics and developing action plans, charters or local agreements that promote shared management of land, water, pastoral areas and transhumance routes.

interventions.title: Prevention and management of climate risks
interventions.text: Conducting vulnerability analyses, developing prevention and preparedness plans, supporting early-warning systems and strengthening institutional coordination at local, national and regional levels.

interventions.title: Anticipating climate-related mobility and displacement
interventions.text: Analysing the environmental and climate drivers of mobility, mapping at-risk areas and integrating anticipation and support measures into territorial policies and plans.

interventions.title: Developing local climate-smart agriculture strategies
interventions.text: Designing and operationalising strategies adapted to local realities, integrating sustainable soil and water management, improved farming practices and producer capacity building.

interventions.title: Diversifying resilient livelihoods
interventions.text: Identifying and developing inclusive economic activities, sustainable value chains and income diversification solutions, with particular attention to women, youth and vulnerable groups.

expertises.impact: Reduce climate vulnerabilities, secure access to natural resources and livelihoods, anticipate mobility and prevent tensions in order to strengthen the resilience and social cohesion of territories.

approach.title: Interventions designed to last
approach.text: SEI combines a cross-cutting reading of environmental, social, climate and territorial issues with an understanding of institutional and socioeconomic realities. Our approach is built on the active participation of institutions, communities, civil society organisations and other stakeholders, together with operational tools that inform decisions, manage risks and sustainably strengthen the resilience of territories.

items.title: Capacity building and knowledge management
items.text: Needs assessment, design and delivery of training, development of guides and practical tools, capturing and sharing knowledge, raising stakeholder awareness and supporting institutional and technical capacity building.

items.title: Design and organisation of strategic events
items.text: Design and organisation of international conferences, high-level dialogues, multi-stakeholder workshops and side events. SEI supports theme definition, mobilising speakers and partners, content preparation, facilitation, communication and capitalising on results.

agenda2030.title: Interventions at the heart of the 2030 Agenda
agenda2030.text: SEI's interventions contribute directly to several Sustainable Development Goals, particularly those related to climate action, land restoration and biodiversity conservation, peace and effective institutions, and partnerships. Our integrated approach translates these global goals into concrete action for the benefit of communities and territories.

This integrated approach delivers reliable, data-driven solutions tailored to territorial realities in order to restore land and ecosystems, manage environmental and social risks, prevent tensions and sustainably strengthen community resilience.
